title: The Knot Invariant Associated to Two-Parameter Quantum Algebras II
summary: Fan, Ma, and Xing constructed oriented-tangle invariants from finite-type two-parameter quantum algebras. In this paper, we construct an explicit parameter-transport comparison between two-parameter modules and their corresponding one-parameter modules, and we verify this comparison on every elementary oriented-tangle operator.
